summary: Anthropic announced updates to Claude Fable 5's biology safety classifiers that reduce false-positive fallbacks to a less capable model by about 85%, while still blocking dual-use biology and drug-development queries.

categories.reason: The update explicitly widens the range of clinical biology tasks Fable 5 can assist healthcare professionals with, crossing into clinical workflows.
categories.quote: Healthcare professionals will be able to receive more support from Fable 5 on clinical tasks.

practices.reason: The classifier retuning directly improves refusal calibration, cutting unnecessary fallback/refusal behavior on benign biology queries by a stated 85%.
practices.quote: In our testing, this update reduced biology-related fallbacks by about 85% across our product surfaces.

practices.reason: The document describes a general methodology for tuning safety classifiers against false positives and false negatives and testing jailbreak robustness, which informs how a team might design and validate its own safety classifiers, though the process itself is lab-internal.
practices.quote: It takes time and iteration to tune the classifiers, avoiding both false positives (where classifiers fire on out-of-scope content) and false negatives (where in-scope content is missed).
